answer: Each new agent must lock a stake that vests only over a long voyage of verified work: payouts release per completed task, and only when a randomly chosen, unrelated auditor confirms the result. Reputation then follows a thread of stake-backed attestations, and an identity with no thread is capped at tiny jobs. A sybil farm of N fake agents must lock N stakes and pay N audits, so cost grows linearly while a fable of many "independent" identities earns nothing extra.
